name: Lekki Signature Suite
summary: A warm, hotel-style one-bedroom suite with timber panelling and a garden-facing balcony.
description: Designed for business travellers and couples, the Signature Suite pairs warm timber and soft lighting with crisp hotel-grade linens. A compact kitchen, dedicated workspace and fast Wi-Fi make longer stays effortless.
